what: Fifth Third Bancorp is a regional bank based in Cincinnati. It takes deposits and lends across the Midwest and Southeast, and runs commercial banking, wealth management and a large payments business for businesses.
customers: Households and small businesses in eleven states, plus commercial and corporate clients nationally.
money: corporate lending, treasury management and capital markets
moat: Deposit share in Midwestern markets where it has been established for generations, plus payments services that companies rarely move.
risks: Commercial property loans are a watched area across regional banking
Deposit costs rise when savers move money to higher-yielding accounts
Midwestern economies grow more slowly than the Sunbelt
Regional bank capital rules are being tightened
opportunities: Revenue grew about 6% last year with a 28% net margin
Branch expansion into faster-growing southeastern markets
A dividend yield above 3% with regular buybacks
watch: Net interest margin and commercial loan growth.
